correctness.rationale: The exact image is obtained from the principal-strip parametrization z=sin(u+iv) and |sin(u+iv)|^2=sin^2 u+sinh^2 v. The affine normalization gives the boundary equation. The sector estimate is elementary and sharp at the cusp; the canonical Ma--Minda extremal proves sharp strong-starlikeness order 1/2. Convexity and the Catalan area formula give independent checks.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. arXiv:2609.20288v1 explicitly gives the incorrect vertical-strip equality and does not state the exact image, sharp sector theorem, or Catalan area. Exact and synonymous searches and the current SCOPE archive found no matching correction/classification. Classical inverse-sine conformal identities are excluded from the novelty claim. The related arXiv:2607.27293v2 full text was not inspected, leaving a stated residual overlap risk.

value.rationale: The correction replaces an unbounded-strip description of the defining Ma--Minda domain by its exact bounded convex geometry and yields a sharp global consequence for the newly studied class: strong starlikeness of exact order 1/2. Finite height and exact area give additional geometric invariants.
